defects: Drops the general offset parameter N present in gold (implicit ℕ argument allowing the ray to start at any natural number) — produced only covers the N = 0 case, losing generality

Hypothesis h_ant : Antitone f is global antitone on all of ℝ, strictly stronger than gold's AntitoneOn f (Ici N) which only requires antitonicity on the ray; even restricted to N=0 this is stronger than AntitoneOn f (Ici 0)
Hypothesis h_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x requires nonnegativity on all of ℝ, strictly stronger than gold's ∀ t ∈ Ioi N, 0 ≤ f t which only requires nonnegativity on the ray
Because the produced hypotheses are strictly stronger than the corresponding N=0 instantiation of gold's hypotheses, the produced theorem is a weaker corollary, not an equivalent restatement
